description: This PHP source file defines the OAuthSubscriber class within the OrangeHRM project. It functions as an event subscriber for handling OAuth-related authentication and authorization processes during HTTP request and response events, including token validation using the League OAuth2 Server library. The class manages OAuth token validation, user authentication credentials, and error handling for OAuth requests within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

classes.name: OAuthSubscriber
classes.description: A class that subscribes to HTTP request and response events to enforce OAuth2 authentication, validate tokens, manage user sessions, and handle related errors within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping HTTP event types to handler methods with their respective priorities for OAuth processing.

methods.name: getAuthenticationService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns an instance of AuthenticationService used for user authentication management.

methods.name: onRequestEvent
methods.description: Handles incoming HTTP requests, checks for OAuth token in headers, validates the token using OAuth2 server, and authenticates the user if valid.

methods.name: handleException
methods.description: Handles exceptions during token validation, returning JSON error response if necessary or throwing session expiration.

methods.name: onResponseEvent
methods.description: Handles outgoing HTTP responses, invalidating the session if OAuth token was used and user was authenticated.
